note: From the 1-ID-Main overview (cs01, CS-Studio): beam order Filter > WB Slits > HE(M), white beam (dark red) up to the HEM, mono beam (light red) after it. The A shutter is not drawn there; the user confirmed (2026-11-12) it sits first, before the filter and the WB slits. A 'Mot' button opens the hutch motor screens. Panels for the WB slits and the HEM are in cs06.

elements.name: A shutter (FES)
elements.long_name: Front-end shutter FES (A station), hutch A
elements.notes: Front-end shutter (PSS name FES). Position CONFIRMED by the user 2026-11-12: first element of hutch A, before the filter and the WB slits. PSS PVs changed in the 2026 Phase II upgrade (old PA:01ID:STA_A_FES_OPEN_PL no longer used).
elements.user: user 2026-11-12: the A shutter is upstream of the white-beam slits and the filter (not drawn on the overview cs01)

elements.name: Filter
elements.notes: Yellow button at the upstream end of hutch A on the 1-ID-Main overview (cs01), before the WB slits (the yellow colour is not explained). The CS-Studio top panel (1ID_top_panel.bob, button under 'Filter') opens the 2-filter panel of IOC 1ida: with four filter selectors fltr1..fltr4 (PVs 1ida:fltrN:select; lock 1ida:fltr_1_2:lock), i.e. the white-beam filter bank. No code device found.

elements.name: WB_slits
elements.notes: White-beam slits. Operator panel (cs06 'W_Beam', labelled 'Looking upstream', so left/right there are mirrored relative to the downstream view used elsewhere in the twin) shows H SIZE, H CENTER, V SIZE, V CENTER, Sync H / Sync V and a Scan button per blade pair. Truncated PV labels: 1ida:Slit1Hsize.DR.., 1ida:Slit1Hcenter.., 1ida:Slit1Vsize.., 1ida:Slit1Vcenter.., 1ida:Slit1Ht2.., 1ida:Slit1Vt2.., blade drives 1ida:Slit1Hxn:DRV / 1ida:Slit1Vxn:DRV. In mpe_bluesky the sizes are read-only signals; the panel allows setting.

elements.name: HEM monochromator
elements.long_name: High-energy monochromator HEM (two crystals: Th1, Th2, Chi2, Z2), hutch A

energy_keV.access: set via record; mpe_bluesky reads hem_energy.a

elements.notes: HEM monochromator, now SEEN: button 'HE' on the 1-ID-Main overview (cs01) above two blue crystal bars; the beam leaving it is drawn as the lighter 'mono' line, displaced from the white beam entering it (plane of the offset not stated). Motor panels in cs06: 1idHEM:m1 and 1idHEM:m4 (axis roles not shown). The CS-Studio display sr/HEM_control_1id.bob (the 'HEM energy change' screen) shows the whole HEM set: six motors 1idHEM:m1, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8 (m5/m6 as tiny panels), the userTran3 record (P 1id:), the undulator control (P S01ID:DSID) and the WB slits, in one place (names of the axes are not on the display; no HEM_Z2 motor in it). Energy is set through the transform record 1id:userTran3 (cs06: 16 rows A-P with input PV, expression CLCA..CLCP, output PV; shown ** DISABLED ** at screenshot time). The 1id:us... keV readout in the C/E panel headers probably comes from it (unverified).

panel.note: panel_x = pixel position of the element along the beam line in that screenshot. SCHEMATIC spacing only (not a distance): it keeps the operator-panel order and relative grouping.
